3.name: Disciple of Life & Preserve Life (Life Domain)
3.description: Healing spells you cast with a spell slot restore an additional 2 + spell slot level HP on the turn cast, and you can use Channel Divinity to distribute 5x Cleric level healing.

6.name: Blessed Healer (Life Domain)
6.description: When you cast a healing spell with a spell slot on another creature, you also regain 2 + spell slot level HP.

17.name: Supreme Healing (Life Domain)
17.description: Instead of rolling dice to heal with a spell or Channel Divinity, use the highest number possible for each die.

3.name: Light Domain Spells & Radiance of the Dawn (Light Domain)
3.description: Always have Light Domain spells prepared, gain the Light cantrip, and expend Channel Divinity to dispel magical darkness and deal Radiant damage in a 30-foot Emanation.

6.name: Improved Warding Flare (Light Domain)
6.description: Regain expended uses of Warding Flare on a Short Rest, and grant the target Temporary HP equal to 2d6 + WIS modifier when Warding Flare triggers.

17.name: Corona of Light (Light Domain)
17.description: Emit Sunlight in a 60-foot radius as a Magic action for 1 minute; enemies in the bright light have Disadvantage on saves against your Radiance of the Dawn and Fire/Radiant spells.

radiance_of_the_dawn.name: Radiance of the Dawn
radiance_of_the_dawn.hint: Channel Divinity 30-ft Emanation dealing 2d10 + Cleric level Radiant damage (CON save for half).

3.name: Blessing of the Trickster & Invoke Duplicity (Trickery Domain)
3.description: Always have Trickery Domain spells prepared, grant Advantage on Stealth checks, and create an illusory duplicate with Channel Divinity to cast from its space.

6.name: Trickster's Transposition (Trickery Domain)
6.description: When creating or moving your Invoke Duplicity illusion as a Bonus Action, you can teleport to swap spaces with it.

17.name: Improved Duplicity (Trickery Domain)
17.description: Grant nearby allies Advantage on attack rolls against foes near your illusion, and heal yourself for Cleric level HP when the illusion ends.

3.name: Guided Strike & War Priest (War Domain)
3.description: Always have War Domain spells prepared, make Bonus Action weapon attacks WIS mod times per rest, and spend Channel Divinity for +10 to a missed attack roll.

6.name: War God's Blessing (War Domain)
6.description: Expend Channel Divinity to cast Shield of Faith or Spiritual Weapon without a spell slot and without requiring Concentration for 1 minute.

17.name: Avatar of Battle (War Domain)
17.description: Gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
